product_one_liner.value: SalesMail provides personalized video messaging and tour-intelligence tools for senior living, home-care, and multifamily teams to engage prospects and customers and improve follow-up.
product_one_liner.notes: HeartLegacy rebranded to SalesMail; answering for the same company/product.

pricing_page.notes: The site navigation/footer lists product, testimonials, integrations and other resources but no pricing page/link.

named_customers.notes: Both appear as named customer testimonial examples.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn provides a count of 16 employees.

hq_location.notes: Company headquarters are listed in Daphne, Alabama, United States.

founded_year.notes: LinkedIn lists founded in 2014; CB Insights corroborates.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index comprises business/product advice and promotional posts; it does not meet the requirement of at least two engineering-authored posts about how the product is built.

public_docs.notes: A public Help Center with multiple knowledge-base articles is available.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The careers page lists openings including Client Success Specialist and Demand Generation Specialist, but no qualifying AI/ML/data-science role.

model_provider.value: Amazon Transcribe (AWS) for transcription and Anthropic Claude for text analysis
model_provider.notes: The company identifies these subprocessors/providers for Sidekick AI features.

compliance_certs.notes: The site says SOC 2 certification is currently in progress, which does not count as a claimed completed certification. No listed named completed certification among the specified set.

last_funding.notes: The company is described as privately owned; the funding profile reveals no verifiable outside funding round or amount. Stage set to none under the specified rule.

raised_18mo.notes: No outside funding rounds are shown; accordingly none is recorded in the 18-month period.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The current openings shown are Client Success Specialist and Demand Generation Specialist, not SDR, BDR, or account executive roles.

launched_6mo.notes: SalesMail announced its Sidekick launch on September 16, 2026, within the six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The current leadership page identifies leaders but does not establish when they joined; no sufficiently supported evidence of a join or departure within the period was found.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The integrations page explicitly names each of these systems.
